subject: Ridgeline Packaging sets price talk on $600M senior secured notes; pricing expected today
body:
Ridgeline Packaging Corp. has set price talk on its $600 million offering of eight-year senior secured notes, according to sources. Talk is in the 7.25%-7.50% area, and the deal is expected to price this afternoon.

Northgate Markets is left lead on the offering, with Westbrook & Co. and Copper Hill Securities as joint bookrunners. Proceeds, together with cash on hand, will be used to fund the acquisition of a regional corrugated-packaging competitor and to pay related fees and expenses.

The notes will be non-callable for three years, with a first call at par plus 50% of the coupon. The notes are rated B+/B2, and the corporate ratings are B/B2, with stable outlooks. Investor calls were held yesterday.

Ridgeline Packaging Corp. is a privately held manufacturer of corrugated and specialty packaging serving food, beverage and industrial customers across North America.
